name: Multi-view Consistency Depth Filtering
definition: A mechanism to verify the accuracy and reliability of each ray before distillation by generating a confidence map based on multi-view consistency between rendered depth and monocular depth.
summary: Multi-view Consistency Depth Filtering verifies monocular depth accuracy by generating a binary confidence map based on geometric consistency with a NeRF, distinguishing itself by using the NeRF as a ground-truth proxy rather than static thresholds.
